_comment: coalescence edge and rhs_bin_moment:1691 consumes it, but LOOP_COAL is
absent from the workbook, the spec and all 79 designs, so it has been 0
in every run of this campaign.  This is the first time it is on.
loop_coal_pref is the capture-geometry prefactor.  D_loop_coal carries
D1D(n)/rot_factor with rot_factor = 1 + B_rot*L_hat^2 = 2.712e6 at the
campaign's L_hat = 1016 -- the rate a randomly placed SPHERICAL sink
sees from a rotating 1-D glider.  A coaxial 1/2<111> loop is a planar
trap, not a sphere, so the true capture rate can exceed that estimate by
up to ~rot_factor.  The ladder 1 / 30 / 1000 spans that range in logs.
SCREEN ONLY, single extent.  Whatever wins gets an I = 160k extent pair
before any claim is made -- a single-grid number is not a result.

admissibility_rule.note: delta_FP is blind to SIA-axis truncation (the <100> pile-up held delta_FP at 1e-8 while 96% of content sat at n=I), so grid adequacy is judged by pile/occupancy. It is NOT blind to the VACANCY axis -- delta_FP rests on the swelling identity S = S_I + Delta J^d and S is the vacancy inventory. The vacancy axis was unchecked until 2026-08-02; at the check_machine probe (V=120) mean_n_v moved 18.7->136 and swelling 58x on going to V=240.
